record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Diglett and Dugtrio (Ground/Normal) and Alolan Diglett and Alolan Dugtrio (Ground/Steel) declare ABILITY DIG (maxPP 50, range 1, no passive). The Ground synergy dig mechanic (Transfer.DIG, ground holes) is a different thing and is NOT covered.
record.summary: Tunnel strike. The caster finds the free cell adjacent to the farthest targetable enemy (same selection as Accelerock/Bounce), collects every enemy on the straight line of cells between its own cell and that destination (supercover line), moves to the destination, then deals flat special damage (10/20/40/80 by stars) to each collected enemy. If no enemy was on the line (or no destination existed) the original cast target is hit instead.

targeting.who: all enemies on the supercover line from the caster's start cell to the destination; fallback: the cast target
targeting.note: requiresTarget keeps the default true. The line is computed before the move. The fallback target is the one passed to the cast, not necessarily next to the destination.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) between the caster's start cell and the destination cell, inclusive of the start cell, with the caster itself excluded by the team test
geometry.detail: getCellsBetween adds the start cell and then every cell the line passes through, including both cells at a diagonal crossing decision; cells off the board are skipped.

effects.target: each enemy on the line (or the cast target)
effects.scaling: handleSpecialDamage(damage, board, SPECIAL, caster, crit) with the default apBoost = true: damage + damage x AP/100, then crit only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT; canCritByDefault false). Each enemy receives one instance.
effects.resolution: handleSpecialDamage then state.handleDamage (defences, shields and item hooks not read); blocked by protect, skydiving, magicBounce.

declaredRaw.note: moveTo(destination, forcedDisplacement false) before the damage

effects.resolution: moveTo swaps cells, puts the caster into MovingState and sets cooldown 100.

starBehavior.note: Caster stars index the damage table (1-4, fallback 80). Catalog units are 1 or 2 stars.

record.positionalConditions: Enemies are hit by lying on the line between the caster's start cell and the destination. With no destination the line is skipped and only the cast target is hit, without moving.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 10/20 special damage per enemy for 1/2 stars; the AP percentage is added and the result goes through generic damage handling. Every enemy on the line takes the full amount.
